title: PUDDLES, AND THE LAMPS IN THEM
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it (item 12, richer ground). When the ground is wet, standing water now shows on the open ground of COLD STORAGE, and every lamp near a puddle throws a streak of its own colour across it, flickering with the lamp. The puddles are always in the same places on the map, never under a roof or on a wall, and they fade in and out with the wetness: on a dry raid there are none. Nothing about play changes.
now: Wet ground on COLD STORAGE now shows puddles, with the lamps reflected in them.
